correct.text: The lecture describes CT as the most reliable imaging modality for diagnosis because it defines pancreatic viability and necrosis.

a.text: Ultrasound is presented as an initial screening test and may be obscured by overlying bowel gas, so it is not the most reliable modality.

d.text: Serum amylase supports the biochemical diagnostic criterion, but it may return to normal within 24–48 hours and is not the most reliable imaging method.
